current_logic.universe_selection: CS_RANK screening with anchor/macro loading; hard-stop if universe < 3 symbols.
current_logic.regime_classification: Canonical 4-state HMM posterior with TVTP and CPU-only JAX bootstrap. The posterior remains the upstream regime prior, but execution no longer depends on a single crisis probability threshold.
current_logic.supervised_tail_separation: Causal IS-trained supervised tail scores are split into q10/q05/q03 tiers across 4h/8h/16h forward-worst horizons. Scores use logistic+isotonic calibration plus rank blending so rare-tail tiers can concentrate crash risk more sharply.
current_logic.regime_boosting: Step 3.5 now forwards supervised score bundles through hazard overlay instead of directly mutating posterior state probabilities.
current_logic.hazard_overlay: Separate tail/crisis hazard layer estimates pre_crisis_hazard, realized_crisis_hazard, and 4h/8h/24h tail hazards from 1h features, regime posterior, and multi-label supervised score bundles.
current_logic.policy_mapping: Policy mapper converts regime posterior and hazard outputs into tiered soft_damp, hard_damp, near_flat, flat, and rebalance controls using exposure multipliers and hazard/tail gates.
current_logic.diagnostics: HMM-only reporting now separates regime quality, execution quality, tiered damp coverage, and supervised score separation diagnostics so precision and coverage can be tracked independently.
current_logic.alpha_generation: LightGBM v6 alpha is regime-conditional, with chop-fragility filtering.
current_logic.risk_management: Tiered execution protection and realized-crisis hazard replace primary dependence on hmm_prob_crisis as the execution control signal.
current_logic.runtime_bootstrap: JAX is pinned to CPU-only initialization in this environment to avoid CUDA plugin probing during imports.
current_logic.parallel_processing: Optimized for 8-core/16GB RAM: 4 workers, 4 chunk size cap to ensure ~4GB RAM per worker.
